migration.description: Add bounded conversation scan continuation, generation-safe staged statistics, automatic retention catch-up and exact hourly backlog observations.
migration.release_unit_description: Bounded retention execution, automatic catch-up and its task observation contract.

durable_state.description: Retention source scope, orphan scan epoch/cursor, generation-checked per-key aggregate staging and source-page cursor, queue mutation generations, nullable run completion, catch-up schedule state, progress evidence and hourly backlog observations.
durable_state.storage_implementation: Additive SQLite structure. Archive/derived correctness remains authoritative in the main database; operational snapshots/results remain in the separate maintenance database.

source_compatibility_range.from_program_versions: Existing retention support boundary v2.71.x through observed v2.80.2; v2.71.45 and v2.80.2 are the declared reproducible fixtures, and unobserved intervening snapshots are not claimed as covered.
source_compatibility_range.to_program_version: Candidate branch th/retention-catchup-observability from origin/main b6829559; delivery commit is recorded at release readiness.

ddl_structural_changes.description: Idempotently install prompt_cache_conversation_stats_refresh_queue generation, generation_clock, refresh_staging and orphan_cleanup_state structures plus existing migration progress; add nullable managed-task result/progress/schedule fields and indexes. Existing deployed migrations are immutable.

Add managed_tasks next_catchup_at and catchup_reason, managed_task_progress next_inspection_at/next_catchup_at/catchup_state, and the maintenance-database retention_backlog_hourly_observations table with an observed-time index. Installation is additive and idempotent; no historical observation rows are fabricated.

Idempotently add the main-database (occurred_at, id) index used by fixed-cohort retention eligibility and hourly backlog observation. Installation is structural only and does not scan or backfill historical observations.

dml_changes.description: Atomically invalidate/enqueue on source mutations, advance the persistent generation clock, checkpoint bounded source pages and conditionally publish precise aggregate results/clear only the consumed generation. Commit orphan deletion with its safe cursor boundary.
Asynchronously publish coalesced operational progress, effective schedule and immutable run results/details to the maintenance database; never add a main-database operational fallback.

After each retention run, schedule one bounded catch-up eligibility at a reason-specific backoff while preserving the inspection schedule; clear it on completion or disablement and enqueue through the existing single managed-task owner.

Run an independent bounded observer against one main-database read snapshot, cancel over-budget SQLite work, and idempotently publish the latest successful UTC-hour count/max-overdue pair to the maintenance database while retaining explicit gaps.

historical_data_backfill_or_transformati.description: No readiness-wide historical scan or fabricated history. Existing durable queue entries initialize conservatively and resume in bounded background pages; absent counters/outcomes/durations stay unknown. Duplicate active maintenance rows are terminalized with an auditable failure result rather than deleted.

progress_signals: Business cursor/generation and last committed progress
Operational observation freshness, effective inspection schedule and next catch-up eligibility
Hourly backlog observation state, observedAt and source cutoff
pause_points: Between idempotent structure installation and background recovery
At each committed business page/batch; operator disable prevents the next batch
Before the next catch-up eligibility; observer failure leaves the bucket missing

recovery.program_rollback_state_behavior: does-not-automatically-reverse-compensate-or-down-migrate; older Minor binaries are not promised to preserve new continuation semantics
recovery.faulty_release_recovery: A newer version recognizes unfinished cursor/staging generations, discards stale derived staging conservatively and resumes the durable queue without changing archive proof or source ownership.

required_test_evidence: Candidate reads the v2.71.45 and v2.80.2 declared retention schema fixtures; original API fields/status remain compatible.
Repeated DDL and re-entry after interruption are idempotent; no historical scan occurs in readiness.
A forward-repair candidate resumes stopped-release staging and cursors without stale publication or lost queue generations.
Legacy missing operational evidence stays unknown and maintenance-store failure does not block business work.
Real SQLite query interruption, rollback and lock release meet the page budget contract.
Catch-up scheduling regression preserves the inspection schedule, applies reason-specific backoff, and clears future work when disabled.
Hourly observer fixtures prove same-snapshot count/max-overdue pairs, idempotent last-success wins, explicit missing buckets and no historical backfill.
Task API and Web chart regressions prove optional-field compatibility, shared hourly axes, readable observedAt/retention policy, and missing versus exact-zero semantics.
The 24-hour fixed-cohort retention capacity card and online-latency comparison remain required before delivery readiness; no empirical pass is claimed yet.

completed_evidence: cargo check and clippy pass on the Candidate; targeted maintenance-store, prompt-cache generation/paging, orphan-retention and retention regressions pass locally.

Web unit tests, typecheck, lint and production build pass locally; Demo task page shows completed/partial, default schedule, stage progress, stale/unknown-compatible fields and unavailable Prompt statistics.
Repeated trigger installation is transactional and idempotent; the generation-clock regression proves queue drain followed by re-enqueue uses a higher generation.
shared-testbox lightweight (1,246/1,246), stateful-sqlite (1,375/1,375), and archive-file-io (299/299) profiles pass.
The earlier same-seed 1,300,000-row result is retained only as Prompt-statistics evidence; it does not exercise retention archive submission and is excluded from the A7 capacity gate.
Current candidate migration, capacity, and visual evidence remain pending until the new main-database index, observer, and catch-up implementation are revalidated together.
Local targeted checks are refreshed incrementally; the final profile, migration, Storybook/E2E, empirical, and review results must be recorded against the delivery commit.
